title: Bank of the Sierra Awards $142K in Grants During Third Quarter of 2026
summary: Porterville, Calif. – Bank of the Sierra is proud to announce that it donated $142,000 to organizations and school districts across its service areas through its Sierra Grant Program during the third quarter of 2026.
body_markdown:
November 09, 2026


*Community Bank’s Sierra Grant Program Supports 49 Community Organizations*


**Porterville, Calif. –** Bank of the Sierra is proud to announce that it donated $142,000 to organizations and school districts across its service areas through its Sierra Grant Program during the third quarter of 2026. Since the program’s inception in 2004, the Bank has awarded more than 2,000 grants, totaling over $5.9 million to organizations that strengthen and improve local communities.


From July through September 2026, more than $87,000 in funding was presented to 26 organizations in the Central Valley. In addition to that amount, over $53,000 was awarded to support 22 organizations in the Bank’s Central Coast market, while $1,000 was distributed to an organization that provides services in multiple regions.


In addition to grants, Bank of the Sierra donated a total of 1,500 backpacks filled with school supplies to 20 local schools. The backpacks were donated near the start of the school year and distributed to students whose families lack the resources to afford the supplies. The Bank also provided a series of financial literacy tips with each backpack to encourage students to save their money, spend wisely, plan for the future, and more.

“From local classrooms to community programs, our Sierra Grant recipients are making a meaningful impact throughout our footprint,” said Kevin McPhaill, Bank of the Sierra President and Chief Executive Officer. “We are pleased to support their efforts and remain committed to investing in initiatives that help our neighborhoods grow stronger.”


**About the Sierra Grant Program**
Since its inception in 2004, the Sierra Grant Program has been responsible for donating more than $5.9 million to organizations that improve local communities.


**About Bank of the Sierra**
Bank of the Sierra is in its 49th year of operations and is the premier independent bank headquartered in the South San Joaquin Valley. Bank of the Sierra is a community-centric regional bank, which offers a broad range of retail and commercial banking services through full-service branches located within the counties of Tulare, Kern, Kings, Fresno, Ventura, San Luis Obispo, and Santa Barbara. Bank of the Sierra is recognized as one of the strongest and top-performing community banks in the country, with a 5-star rating from Bauer Financial.
